description: This file defines the AWS CloudWatchLogsClient class for interacting with Amazon CloudWatch Logs service. It extends AwsClient, includes method annotations for various CloudWatch Logs operations, manages streaming commands, and provides helper methods for starting live tail sessions and processing log streams.

classes.name: CloudWatchLogsClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon CloudWatch Logs service, enabling operations such as log management, stream handling, and real-time tailing with support for streaming commands and callback middleware.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the client with provided configuration and adds streaming middleware for specific commands.

methods.name: addStreamingFlagMiddleware
methods.description: Adds middleware to flag streaming commands with a special HTTP request attribute.

methods.name: getStreamingFlagMiddleware
methods.description: Returns a callable middleware that sets the '@http' stream flag for streaming commands.

methods.name: startLiveTailCheckingForResults
methods.description: Starts a live tail session and yields log stream chunks when results are available, handling session updates and results asynchronously.
